clock: Raw positive odd-only map; state1 is not absorbed.

generated_words.scope: All displayed positive words are realized exactly; repeated words are counted and excluded from simple-cycle order tests. Primitive rotations are counted separately in this generated grid, unlike the deduplicated actual census.

narrow_full_period_discrepancy_control.scope: One period has length2; this does not discard the m/L term in a valid discrepancy estimate.
narrow_full_period_discrepancy_control.statement: A-m*log_2(3)>1 over the complete odd period although H<2L.

normalization: Each actual cycle is reduced by its common odd scaling; normalized cycles are deduplicated by reduced denominator and the minimum-oriented numerator cycle. Mantissas z=n/2^h lie in [L,2L), with L=min n, and represent q times the rational mantissas.

pair_controls.scope: Pairs of actual odd inputs, not asserted to lie in one cycle. Equality pairs have the same odd successor and therefore cannot both be distinct states of a simple cycle. The q1 inversion restriction is exercised nonvacuously here.

scope: Every actual arrow and each distinct normalized pair is checked exactly. Full rows, source associations and pair audits enter deterministic digests. The actual sample and generated grid are finite; zero observed cases are not universal exclusions. q1 only has its fixed cycle in these cycle samples; separate input-pair controls exercise the q1 inversion threshold. Written arguments are separate from this receipt.
